insight: YC S24; raised a $3.9M seed led by Nat Friedman & Daniel Gross (NFDG), with backing from execs at NVIDIA, OpenAI, and Ramp.
name: Pulse
description: A document-extraction platform that converts messy, real-world documents — financial statements, medical records, contracts, spreadsheets — into clean, LLM-ready structured data. Pulse runs its own OCR, layout, and vision models (including its Ultra extraction model) rather than wrapping a general-purpose LLM, and exposes the pipeline through an API that drops into existing data workflows. It offers a free sandbox to try, with enterprise tiers for scale; the company says it has processed over a billion document pages.
